description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'RecruitmentAttachmentDao' for handling recruitment-related attachments (vacancy, candidate, interview) within the OrangeHRM application. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting attachment entities, as well as querying attachment IDs based on various filters and user roles.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for accessing and managing recruitment attachment entities in the database, including CRUD operations and complex queries based on roles and filters.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing VacancyAttachments from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Fetches a partial RecruitmentAttachment for a candidate by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateAttachment entity by candidate ID.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks if a candidate has any attachment.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Fetches a partial RecruitmentAttachment for an interview attachment by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Retrieves all attachments associated with a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Returns the count of attachments for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a candidate attachment by candidate ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for interview attachment queries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of interview attachments matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all interview attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all vacancy attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Returns attachment IDs for vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Returns attachment IDs for interviews related to vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns attachment IDs for interviews accessible to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Private method that retrieves interview IDs accessible to a given interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing interview attachments for a list of IDs and an interview ID.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes specific interview attachments associated with an interview ID.
